verdict.rationale: Nix offers CLI commands for upgrading and rolling back packages (`nix-env --upgrade`, `nix-env --rollback`), and its operations are atomic. However, this is imperative profile management, not CLI rewriting of a declarative manifest (flake.nix, configuration.nix) and its lockfile. The evidence shows users write those specifications by hand. Missing for 10: CLI commands to add or remove dependencies in a manifest, documented lockfile update or rewrite commands (e.g. flake lock management), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-safe dependency editing.
